Capture the source

Know whether an enquiry came from a campaign, form, referral or connected conversation. Source information becomes more useful when linked to the opportunity that follows.

Assign the response

A captured enquiry needs a responsible person or agreed AI-supported workflow. Decide what information is needed and what should happen next.

Connect the journey

Use appropriate forms, landing pages and connected advertising forms where configured. Avoid treating a form submission as permission for unrelated marketing.
